I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was Pine Crossing.

She raised it herself in #central-team on 9 June. The morning receiver said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift, and when a driver arrived at 7:10 they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

I couldn't find any Marrow Agrisupply account files in the share, so all I could give her is the store name. I told her I don't have an address or site ID for it.
